pref.unitSystem.description: Which units are suggested first when you type a quantity such as “10 km”.

pref.chineseUnits.description: Also suggest Chinese market units (斤, 两, 亩, 尺, 寸, 里…). They can always be typed.
pref.significantDigits.title: Significant digits
pref.significantDigits.description: How many significant digits unit conversions show (1–30).
pref.dpi.title: Screen DPI
pref.dpi.description: Pixels per inch for converting px to physical units such as pt, mm and in.
pref.remBase.title: Root font size (px)
pref.currencyProvider.title: Exchange rates
pref.currencyProvider.description: Where currency rates come from. They are downloaded at most every 6 hours, need no API key, and are kept for offline use. Rates by Exchange Rate API (open.er-api.com, about 160 currencies, daily) or Frankfurter (European Central Bank, about 30 currencies, working days).
pref.currencies.title: Currencies
pref.currencies.description: ISO codes of the currencies an amount such as “100 usd” is converted to.
pref.yenMeansJPY.title: ¥ means Japanese yen
pref.yenMeansJPY.description: Read ¥ and ￥ as Japanese yen (JPY) instead of Chinese yuan (CNY).
